Magnifique séjour dans cette très belle villa, très agréable et confortable, en pleine nature avec une vue superbe sur la mer. Salon et espace cuisine très spacieux, et une piscine et terrasse avec la vue. À 15 mn en voiture de la plage et à 40 mn de Grenade , endroit idéal pour une escapade de quelques jours au soleil. Hôtes accueillants et réactifs.
  
 
 Posted on Google  
 
 
 
  
 
 
 Pichon Marc 
 
 
 
 
  
 
 
  
Nous avons passé un merveilleux week-end en famille : c'est le lieu idéal pour se ressourcer et profiter pleinement d’un break ou des vacances ! Nous avons été très bien accueillis et renseignés et cela jusqu'à notre départ. Les oliviers  ET la vue imprenable sur les collines environnantes et la mer vous charmeront tout au long de votre séjour. Un vrai paradis, un havre de pays. Merci encore !
  
 
 Posted on Google  
 
 
 
  
 
 
 Sophie BILLAUX 
 
 
 
 
  
 
 
  
Hermoso lugar para relajarse con familia o amigos!
Tiene todo lo necesario para distenderse, pasar tiempo de calidad y relax
Super recomendable!

Nous avons passé un agreable sejour a plusieurs couples ainsi qu'avec les enfants. Que ce soit autour de la piscine ou sur les terrasses, les superbes vues panoramiques sont magnifiques depuis n' importe quel endroit de la maison.
Ce cadre se trouve ideal pour se retrouver en famille ou avec des amis.

Une super vue, piscine incroyable, propriétaire accessibles, des vacances formidables en perspective. Gracias mucho por todo
  
 
 Posted on Google

Preciosa villa para ir en familia! Super recomendable, la atención, ubicación, todo increíble!!!

Amazing house located above the city of Motril with incredible views of the sea as well as the avocado and mango fields surrounding the house. Very nicely decorated and with spacious rooms all with en-suite bathrooms and a superb kitchen and living room offering great views of the sunset. The house also has a great swimming pool and a jacuzzi on the roof terrace.
Great place to spend a relaxing few days with friends or family. It won’t disappoint!

Wonderful stay. Absolutely amazing views & beautiful villa. Great for large groups. Hosts
very helpful & friendly. Easy access to town with a car.

About us

As a family-run retreat, welcoming you to Villa La Playa is not just a tradition—it’s our passion. Our commitment to crafting an exceptional experience stems from generations of heartfelt hospitality.

From our family to yours, we invite you to share in our slice of paradise, where every corner embodies warmth, care, and the spirit of coastal living. We can’t wait to share our Villa La Playa with you and create unforgettable memories together.

Our locations

Discover the beauty of Spain’s Costa Tropical with our handpicked holiday rental homes. Whether you’re looking to unwind in a charming coastal town or experience the ultimate beachfront escape, we offer two unique destinations that promise relaxation, adventure, and unforgettable memories.

content.rendered:
Experiences

Elevate your stay at Villa La Playa

Enhance your stay at Villa La Playa with our tailored in-villa services, from private chefs crafting exquisite meals to Private events catering, ensuring every moment is luxuriously catered to your desires. 

We’ve created 2 different customized Guidebooks for our guests. The first generic using AirBNB guidebook style can be found here -> Guidebook. We have a second Guidebook, specially tailored by ourselves with anything from private chef details, restaurants and much more, send us an email to request it. 

Private chef

Elevate your stay at the villa with a private chef experience. Indulge in exquisite, customized meals crafted to your taste, ensuring a culinary journey that mirrors the luxury of your surroundings.

Wellness

Rejuvenate with our exclusive wellness offerings at the villa. Pamper yourself with personalized spa treatments, yoga sessions, and holistic activities, ensuring a tranquil escape that harmonizes with the serene ambiance.

Private events

Celebrate in style with private events at the villa. Our exquisite venue and personalized services create the perfect setting for corporate retreats, parties, and gatherings. Contact us to tailor a memorable event.

Things to do nearby Villa La Playa

Explore the wonders around Villa La Playa with our assistance in booking local excursions, from mesmerising tours of historic landmarks to thrilling water activities, ensuring your experience beyond the villa is as memorable as your stay within

For the lazy days

Beaches and creeks

Discover Costa Tropical’s pristine beaches and hidden creeks just a short drive from the villa. Bask in the sun and dip into the turquoise waters during the summer months. We know the best beaches and can plan exclusive boat trips for you. Contact us to customize your coastal experience.

Contact us

For the culture lover

Granada

Discover Granada’s history at the Alhambra and Albayzín, then immerse yourself in the city’s royal past. Enhance your experience by hiring a private tour guide for a personalized exploration—contact us to arrange your day of cultural enrichment. Granada’s gems is just a short drive away (45 min) from the villa. Contact us to customize your experience or directly book entrance to the famous Alhambra on their official website.

Official website

Nerja & around

Explore the enchanting town of Nerja and its famous caves, as well as the picturesque village of Frigiliana, all on a convenient full-day trip from the villa. Contact us to customize your experience or directly book entrance to the famous Cuevas de Nerja on their official website.

Official website

Alpujarra

Embark on a half day journey from the villa to Alpujarra. Explore charming villages such as Capileira and Pampaneira, terraced landscapes, and centuries-old traditions. Arrange a private guide for a personalized cultural tour, unveiling the Moorish and Spanish heritage that defines this enchanting region.

Contact us

For the sports enthusiast

Water sports

Motril’s water sports scene is a thrilling playground for aquatic enthusiasts. With its stunning coastline, the town offers an array of activities such as windsurfing, kiteboarding, and sailing. Dive into the crystal-clear waters and explore the Mediterranean’s wonders through diving or snorkeling adventures

Contact us

Tennis and Paddle

The tennis and padel clubs in Motril cater to sports enthusiasts seeking active and enjoyable experiences. These clubs provide top-notch facilities, including multiple courts for tennis and padel, welcoming players of all skill levels.

Contact us

Golf

The Motril Golf Club offers golf enthusiasts a picturesque haven nestled in the heart of Costa Tropical. With an 18-hole course boasting stunning views of the Mediterranean Sea and Sierra Nevada mountains, it’s a golfer’s paradise.

Official website

For the foodies

Malaga

Malaga’s iconic ‘espetos’ showcase the essence of Mediterranean cuisine, featuring skewered fresh sardines grilled over an open flame right on the beach, delivering a taste of seaside perfection.

Contact us

Granada

Granada’s culinary scene tantalizes with its fusion of traditional Spanish flavors and Moorish influences, offering a delectable array of tapas, rich stews, and sweet treats like the famous ‘Torta de la Virgen’

Contact us

Around Villa Los Olivos

Discover our top picks around Villa Los Olivos such as La Roka or other hidden gems that will make you feel like a local.

Villa La Playa

Your luxury beach house holiday rental in the Costa tropical

Welcome to Villa La Playa

Welcome to Villa La Playa

Nestled along the stunning coastline of the Costa Tropical, Villa La Playa is more than just a getaway; it’s a sanctuary built with our family’s love for hospitality. This beachside haven offers the perfect escape on the sun-kissed shores of Calahonda, providing an ideal retreat for those seeking both relaxation and adventure.

As a family-run property, we are committed to making your stay an unforgettable experience, filled with comfort, personalized care, and a warm, welcoming ambiance.

Bask in the Costa Tropical’s inviting climate, where sunshine and coastal breezes greet you every day. Your journey to Spain’s serene beach paradise begins here.

But don’t just take our word for it. Here’s what some of our past guests had to say about Villa La Playa.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
  
 
 
  
Magnifique séjour dans cette très belle villa, très agréable et confortable, en pleine nature avec une vue superbe sur la mer. Salon et espace cuisine très spacieux, et une piscine et terrasse avec la vue. À 15 mn en voiture de la plage et à 40 mn de Grenade , endroit idéal pour une escapade de quelques jours au soleil. Les oliviers  ET la vue imprenable sur les collines environnantes et la mer vous charmeront tout au long de votre séjour. Un vrai paradis, un havre de pays. Merci encore !

content.rendered:
Experiences

Elevate your stay at Villa Los Olivos

Enhance your stay at Villa Los Olivos with our tailored in-villa services, from private chefs crafting exquisite meals to Private events catering, ensuring every moment is luxuriously catered to your desires. 

We’ve created 2 different customized Guidebooks for our guests. The first generic using AirBNB guidebook style can be found here -> Guidebook. We have a second Guidebook, specially tailored by ourselves with anything from private chef details, restaurants and much more, send us an email to request it. 

Private chef

Elevate your stay at the villa with a private chef experience. Indulge in exquisite, customized meals crafted to your taste, ensuring a culinary journey that mirrors the luxury of your surroundings.

Wellness

Rejuvenate with our exclusive wellness offerings at the villa. Pamper yourself with personalized spa treatments, yoga sessions, and holistic activities, ensuring a tranquil escape that harmonizes with the serene ambiance.

Private events

Celebrate in style with private events at the villa. Our exquisite venue and personalized services create the perfect setting for corporate retreats, parties, and gatherings. Contact us to tailor a memorable event.

Things to do nearby Villa Los Olivos

Explore the wonders around Villa Los Olivos with our assistance in booking local excursions, from mesmerising tours of historic landmarks to thrilling water activities, ensuring your experience beyond the villa is as memorable as your stay within

For the lazy days

Beaches and creeks

Discover Costa Tropical’s pristine beaches and hidden creeks just a short drive from the villa. Bask in the sun and dip into the turquoise waters during the summer months. We know the best beaches and can plan exclusive boat trips for you. Contact us to customize your coastal experience.

Contact us

For the culture lover

Granada

Discover Granada’s history at the Alhambra and Albayzín, then immerse yourself in the city’s royal past. Enhance your experience by hiring a private tour guide for a personalized exploration—contact us to arrange your day of cultural enrichment. Granada’s gems is just a short drive away (45 min) from the villa. Contact us to customize your experience or directly book entrance to the famous Alhambra on their official website.

Official website

Nerja & around

Explore the enchanting town of Nerja and its famous caves, as well as the picturesque village of Frigiliana, all on a convenient full-day trip from the villa. Contact us to customize your experience or directly book entrance to the famous Cuevas de Nerja on their official website.

Official website

Alpujarra

Embark on a half day journey from the villa to Alpujarra. Explore charming villages such as Capileira and Pampaneira, terraced landscapes, and centuries-old traditions. Arrange a private guide for a personalized cultural tour, unveiling the Moorish and Spanish heritage that defines this enchanting region.

Contact us

For the sports enthusiast

Water sports

Motril’s water sports scene is a thrilling playground for aquatic enthusiasts. With its stunning coastline, the town offers an array of activities such as windsurfing, kiteboarding, and sailing. Dive into the crystal-clear waters and explore the Mediterranean’s wonders through diving or snorkeling adventures

Contact us

Tennis and Paddle

The tennis and padel clubs in Motril cater to sports enthusiasts seeking active and enjoyable experiences. These clubs provide top-notch facilities, including multiple courts for tennis and padel, welcoming players of all skill levels.

Contact us

Golf

The Motril Golf Club offers golf enthusiasts a picturesque haven nestled in the heart of Costa Tropical. With an 18-hole course boasting stunning views of the Mediterranean Sea and Sierra Nevada mountains, it’s a golfer’s paradise.

Official website

For the foodies

Malaga

Malaga’s iconic ‘espetos’ showcase the essence of Mediterranean cuisine, featuring skewered fresh sardines grilled over an open flame right on the beach, delivering a taste of seaside perfection.

Contact us

Granada

Granada’s culinary scene tantalizes with its fusion of traditional Spanish flavors and Moorish influences, offering a delectable array of tapas, rich stews, and sweet treats like the famous ‘Torta de la Virgen’

Contact us

Around Villa Los Olivos

Discover our top picks around Villa Los Olivos such as La Roka or other hidden gems that will make you feel like a local.

Contact us

Discover Villa Los Olivos

Drop us a line and let’s start planning your dream getaway at Villa Los Olivos. We’re here to make your stay extraordinary!

Contact us

Don't take our word for it

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
  
 
 
  
Magnifique séjour dans cette très belle villa, très agréable et confortable, en pleine nature avec une vue superbe sur la mer. Salon et espace cuisine très spacieux, et une piscine et terrasse avec la vue. À 15 mn en voiture de la plage et à 40 mn de Grenade , endroit idéal pour une escapade de quelques jours au soleil. Hôtes accueillants et réactifs.
  
 
 Posted on Google  
 
 
 
  
 
 
 Pichon Marc 
 
 
 
 
  
 
 
  
Nous avons passé un merveilleux week-end en famille : c'est le lieu idéal pour se ressourcer et profiter pleinement d’un break ou des vacances ! Nous avons été très bien accueillis et renseignés et cela jusqu'à notre départ. Les oliviers  ET la vue imprenable sur les collines environnantes et la mer vous charmeront tout au long de votre séjour. Un vrai paradis, un havre de pays. Merci encore !
  
 
 Posted on Google  
 
 
 
  
 
 
 Sophie BILLAUX 
 
 
 
 
  
 
 
  
Hermoso lugar para relajarse con familia o amigos!
Tiene todo lo necesario para distenderse, pasar tiempo de calidad y relax
Super recomendable!
  
 
 Posted on Google  
 
 
 
  
 
 
 julieta kapusta 
 
 
 
 
  
 
 
  
Nous avons passé un agreable sejour a plusieurs couples ainsi qu'avec les enfants. Que ce soit autour de la piscine ou sur les terrasses, les superbes vues panoramiques sont magnifiques depuis n' importe quel endroit de la maison.
Ce cadre se trouve ideal pour se retrouver en famille ou avec des amis.
  
 
 Posted on Google  
 
 
 
  
 
 
 Francisco Martin 
 
 
 
 
  
 
 
  
Une super vue, piscine incroyable, propriétaire accessibles, des vacances formidables en perspective. Gracias mucho por todo
  
 
 Posted on Google  
 
 
 
  
 
 
 BlindYasu _. 
 
 
 
 
  
 
 
  
Preciosa villa para ir en familia! Super recomendable, la atención, ubicación, todo increíble!!!
  
 
 Posted on Google  
 
 
 
  
 
 
 federico devoto 
 
 
 
 
  
 
 
  
Amazing house located above the city of Motril with incredible views of the sea as well as the avocado and mango fields surrounding the house. Very nicely decorated and with spacious rooms all with en-suite bathrooms and a superb kitchen and living room offering great views of the sunset. The house also has a great swimming pool and a jacuzzi on the roof terrace.
Great place to spend a relaxing few days with friends or family. It won’t disappoint!
  
 
 Posted on Google  
 
 
 
  
 
 
 Marina Jane 
 
 
 
 
  
 
 
  
Wonderful stay. Absolutely amazing views & beautiful villa. Great for large groups. Hosts
very helpful & friendly. Easy access to town with a car.
  
 
 Posted on Google  
 
 
 
  
 
 
 Laura Hardcastle 
 
 
 
 
  
 
 
  
Espectacular villa para pasar unos días de relax con amigos o familia. Tiene todo lo que necesitas para que tu estancia sea amena, además de una piscina privada y vistas geniales. Totalmente recomendable.
  
 
 Posted on Google  
 
 
 
  
 
 
 R Gomez 
 
 
 
 
  
 
 
  
A wonderful villa with a fantastic view of the main town and the sea, perfect for large groups including families, had a lovely time there.

 James Shaw

About us

As a family-run retreat, welcoming you to Villa Los Olivos is not just a tradition—it’s our passion. Our commitment to crafting an exceptional experience stems from generations of heartfelt hospitality.

 

From our family to yours, we invite you to share in our slice of paradise, where every corner embodies warmth, care, and the spirit of coastal living. We can’t wait to share our Villa Los Olivos with you and create unforgettable memories together.

Villa Los Olivos

Your luxury holiday rental in the Costa tropical

Welcome to Villa Los Olivos

Nestled amidst the captivating landscape of the Costa Tropical, our villa is more than just a destination; it’s a haven crafted with our family’s passion for hospitality. Villa Los Olivos is your exclusive retreat on the sun-kissed shores of Motril in La Costa Tropical.

As a family-run business, we offer full services , like cleaning and cooking for a memorable journey filled with comfort, care, and a warm, welcoming atmosphere.

Experience the consistent charm of the Costa Tropical’s inviting climate, promising sun-drenched days throughout your stay. Your journey into Spain’s coastal paradise begins here. 

But don’t take our word for it. Here is what some of our previous visitors said about Villa Los Olivos.

Welcome to Villa Los Olivos​

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
  
 
 
  
Magnifique séjour dans cette très belle villa, très agréable et confortable, en pleine nature avec une vue superbe sur la mer. Salon et espace cuisine très spacieux, et une piscine et terrasse avec la vue. À 15 mn en voiture de la plage et à 40 mn de Grenade , endroit idéal pour une escapade de quelques jours au soleil. Hôtes accueillants et réactifs.
  
 
 Posted on Google  
 
 
 
  
 
 
 Pichon Marc 
 
 
 
 
  
 
 
  
Nous avons passé un merveilleux week-end en famille : c'est le lieu idéal pour se ressourcer et profiter pleinement d’un break ou des vacances ! Nous avons été très bien accueillis et renseignés et cela jusqu'à notre départ. Les oliviers  ET la vue imprenable sur les collines environnantes et la mer vous charmeront tout au long de votre séjour. Un vrai paradis, un havre de pays. Merci encore !
  
 
 Posted on Google  
 
 
 
  
 
 
 Sophie BILLAUX 
 
 
 
 
  
 
 
  
Hermoso lugar para relajarse con familia o amigos!
Tiene todo lo necesario para distenderse, pasar tiempo de calidad y relax
Super recomendable!
  
 
 Posted on Google  
 
 
 
  
 
 
 julieta kapusta 
 
 
 
 
  
 
 
  
Nous avons passé un agreable sejour a plusieurs couples ainsi qu'avec les enfants. Que ce soit autour de la piscine ou sur les terrasses, les superbes vues panoramiques sont magnifiques depuis n' importe quel endroit de la maison.
Ce cadre se trouve ideal pour se retrouver en famille ou avec des amis.
  
 
 Posted on Google  
 
 
 
  
 
 
 Francisco Martin 
 
 
 
 
  
 
 
  
Une super vue, piscine incroyable, propriétaire accessibles, des vacances formidables en perspective. Gracias mucho por todo
  
 
 Posted on Google  
 
 
 
  
 
 
 BlindYasu _. 
 
 
 
 
  
 
 
  
Preciosa villa para ir en familia! Super recomendable, la atención, ubicación, todo increíble!!!
  
 
 Posted on Google  
 
 
 
  
 
 
 federico devoto 
 
 
 
 
  
 
 
  
Amazing house located above the city of Motril with incredible views of the sea as well as the avocado and mango fields surrounding the house. Very nicely decorated and with spacious rooms all with en-suite bathrooms and a superb kitchen and living room offering great views of the sunset. The house also has a great swimming pool and a jacuzzi on the roof terrace.
Great place to spend a relaxing few days with friends or family. It won’t disappoint!
  
 
 Posted on Google  
 
 
 
  
 
 
 Marina Jane 
 
 
 
 
  
 
 
  
Wonderful stay. Absolutely amazing views & beautiful villa. Great for large groups. Hosts
very helpful & friendly. Easy access to town with a car.
  
 
 Posted on Google  
 
 
 
  
 
 
 Laura Hardcastle 
 
 
 
 
  
 
 
  
Espectacular villa para pasar unos días de relax con amigos o familia. Tiene todo lo que necesitas para que tu estancia sea amena, además de una piscina privada y vistas geniales. Totalmente recomendable.
  
 
 Posted on Google  
 
 
 
  
 
 
 R Gomez 
 
 
 
 
  
 
 
  
A wonderful villa with a fantastic view of the main town and the sea, perfect for large groups including families, had a lovely time there.
  
 
 Posted on Google  
 
 
 
  
 
 
 James Shaw

Panoramic Views

Perched in the hills overlooking Motril, Villa Los Olivos offers breathtaking panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea and the Sierra Nevada mountains

Comfortable Rooms

Indulge in spacious elegance and impeccable design within our exquisitely decorated rooms, each a sanctuary of comfort and style

Full Amenities

From an infinity pool to a relaxing Jacuzzi with views and an array of enticing features, We offer all services like cleaning and cooking on-site.

Getting to Villa Los Olivos

Located in the heart of the Costa Tropical, Villa Los Olivos enjoys seamless connectivity to both Malaga and Granada, allowing easy access to the vibrant culture, history, and airports of these iconic cities within a comfortable driving distance.
